definitions.gloss: point-blank range; very close distance; close proximity
definitions.explanation: An extremely short distance between two things. Originally a military/firearms term for the distance at which a bullet travels in a nearly flat trajectory, now commonly used to mean simply 'very close.'

examples.japanese: {至近距離|しきんきょり}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}した→撮影する：21990_satsueisuru⟧。
examples.english: I photographed it from very close range.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{至近距離|しきんきょり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧だ。
examples.english: It's an apartment building very close to the station.

examples.japanese: {至近距離|しきんきょり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When I looked from up close, there were many small scratches.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both literally (physical distance) and in real estate/location descriptions. Often seen in property listings to emphasize proximity to a station or other amenity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {至近距離|しきんきょり}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from very close range)
- {至近距離|しきんきょり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to be located very close by)
- {至近距離|しきんきょり}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see from close up)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{近距離|きんきょり}→近距離：19019_kinkyori⟧: short distance — less extreme than {至近距離|しきんきょり}
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: right under one's nose — idiomatic expression for very near
